headline: **MLB Daily Recap: June 26, 2026**
article:
The Houston Astros suffered a blowout loss to the Detroit Tigers, while the Cincinnati Reds secured a crucial victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates. The Washington Nationals fell short against the Baltimore Orioles, and the Texas Rangers edged the Toronto Blue Jays in a thrilling 5-4 win.

Top MLB news saw the Astros fall to the Tigers in an 8-0 loss, with James Outman leading the Astros' offense and Keider Montero pitching a strong 7.0 innings for the Tigers. The Reds took down the Pirates 6-4, with Noelvi Marte leading the offense and recording his 4th home run of the season. The Nationals fell short in Baltimore, with Trevor Rogers earning the win and Blaze Alexander leading the Nationals' offense. The Rangers secured a hard-fought win over the Blue Jays, with Justin Foscue leading the Rangers' offense.

Several players have been impacted by injuries, with Daniel Susac being placed on the 10-day injured list by the San Francisco Giants due to a low back strain. Phil Maton has been placed on the 15-day injured list by the Chicago Cubs with right knee tendinitis, while Marcelo Mayer has been placed on the 10-day injured list by the Boston Red Sox with a bone stress reaction to the left ulna.

The Chicago Cubs have acquired left-handed pitcher David Peterson in a trade, while the Giants have placed catcher Daniel Susac on the 10-day injured list.

top_news.title: **Astros Fall to Tigers in Blowout**
top_news.summary: The Houston Astros suffered an 8-0 loss to the Detroit Tigers, marking a disappointing end to the game. James Outman led the Astros' offense with a home run and three RBIs, while Keider Montero pitched a strong 7.0 innings for the Tigers, allowing no earned runs.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Pirates 6-4**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a 6-4 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Noelvi Marte leading the offense. Marte's 4th home run of the season, a line drive to left center field, scored Sal Stewart and proved crucial in the Reds' win.

top_news.title: **Nationals Fall Short in Baltimore**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals dropped a 1-3 decision to the Baltimore Orioles, with Trevor Rogers earning the win despite allowing just one earned run over 6.1 innings. Blaze Alexander led the Nationals' offense with a 2-RBI performance.

top_news.title: **Rangers Edge Blue Jays in Thrilling 5-4 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Texas Rangers secured a hard-fought win over the Toronto Blue Jays, with a final score of 5-4. Justin Foscue led the Rangers' offense with a strong performance, recording 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Giants Place C Daniel Susac on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: San Francisco Giants catcher Daniel Susac has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a low back strain.

top_news.title: **Cubs Acquire Left-Handed Pitcher in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs have acquired left-handed pitcher David Peterson in a trade. Peterson joins the Cubs after being previously traded to the team.
